ar/public.home.meta.description: Open event infrastructure. Publish events, register attendees, sell or give away tickets, message your community and check people in. 0.99% on paid tickets, free events are free, or self-host for nothing.
ar/public.home.pricing.title: Lower fees than any other platform.
ar/public.home.pricing.body: Most platforms take 3 to 5 percent plus a fee on every ticket. Evnelo takes 0.99% on paid tickets and nothing on free ones. You connect your own Stripe account, so ticket money goes straight to you and never sits with us; Stripe’s processing fee applies at Stripe’s rate, and you can pass fees to buyers or absorb them.
ar/public.home.pricing.plans.free.title: Free events
ar/public.home.pricing.plans.free.note: No platform fee, no per-ticket fee, unlimited attendees.
ar/public.home.pricing.plans.paid.title: Paid events
ar/public.home.pricing.plans.paid.note: On the ticket price, charged through your connected Stripe account. A $25 ticket costs you 25 cents, plus Stripe.
ar/public.home.pricing.plans.selfHosted.title: Self-hosted
ar/public.home.pricing.plans.selfHosted.note: Open source. One container, your MySQL, your own Stripe keys. No platform fee, ever.
ar/public.home.flow.title: Everything between “I want to go” and “I’m here”.
ar/public.home.flow.steps.publish.title: Publish
ar/public.home.flow.steps.publish.text: An event page with your cover, schedule, venue and hosts. Public, unlisted, or private by invitation.
ar/public.home.flow.steps.register.title: Register
ar/public.home.flow.steps.register.text: Ticket tiers, your own questions, guests with their own tickets, discount codes, a waitlist when you sell out.
ar/public.home.flow.steps.pay.title: Pay and receive
ar/public.home.flow.steps.pay.text: Cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Pix. Tickets with a QR code, wallet passes, calendar files, confirmation by email and SMS.
ar/public.home.flow.steps.checkin.title: Check in
ar/public.home.flow.steps.checkin.text: A scanner that runs in any phone browser, keeps working without signal, and shows the room filling up live.
ar/public.home.openSource.title: Your events. Your data. Your stack.
ar/public.home.openSource.body: Evnelo is open source under the Apache 2.0 license. Host it yourself with one container and one MySQL database, plug in your own Stripe, Resend and Vonage keys, and keep every attendee record on your own infrastructure. Same product, no platform fee.

hi/manage.ticketTypes.title: Ticket types

mr/manage.ticketTypes.title: Ticket types
mr/manage.ticketTypes.descriptionEmpty: Publishing without a ticket type creates a free General admission ticket automatically.

mr/manage.discounts.title: Discount codes
mr/manage.discounts.description: Percent or fixed amount off the order. Buyers enter the code at checkout; it applies to every ticket in the order.

mr/manage.invites.title: Invitations
mr/manage.invites.description: One link per guest, or one link for everyone. Each invite tracks how many times it has been used.
mr/manage.invites.privateNote: This event is private: only people who open an invitation link (or members of your organization) can see it and register. Email invites only work with the address they were sent to.
mr/manage.invites.publicNote: Invitations only restrict access on private events. This event is {visibility}, so anyone with the link can register; you can still send invites as a courtesy.
mr/manage.invites.form.help: Leave the email empty for a shareable link anyone can use.
mr/manage.invites.empty.title: No invitations yet
mr/manage.invites.empty.description: Create one above to hand out a link, or address it to a single email.
mr/manage.invites.confirmRevoke: Revoke this invitation? The link stops working immediately.
mr/manage.waitlist.title: Waitlist
mr/manage.waitlist.description: The queue that forms once the event sells out.

mr/manage.waitlist.disabledNote: The waitlist is off for this event (Edit → Registration options). People who joined earlier are still listed here.
mr/manage.waitlist.empty.title: Nobody on the waitlist

zh-CN/public.home.meta.title: Evnelo: events, in motion
zh-CN/public.home.meta.description: Open event infrastructure. Publish events, register attendees, sell or give away tickets, message your community and check people in. 0.99% on paid tickets, free events are free, or self-host for nothing.
zh-CN/public.home.pricing.title: Lower fees than any other platform.
zh-CN/public.home.pricing.body: Most platforms take 3 to 5 percent plus a fee on every ticket. Evnelo takes 0.99% on paid tickets and nothing on free ones. You connect your own Stripe account, so ticket money goes straight to you and never sits with us; Stripe’s processing fee applies at Stripe’s rate, and you can pass fees to buyers or absorb them.
zh-CN/public.home.pricing.plans.free.title: Free events
zh-CN/public.home.pricing.plans.free.note: No platform fee, no per-ticket fee, unlimited attendees.
zh-CN/public.home.pricing.plans.paid.title: Paid events
zh-CN/public.home.pricing.plans.paid.note: On the ticket price, charged through your connected Stripe account. A $25 ticket costs you 25 cents, plus Stripe.
zh-CN/public.home.pricing.plans.selfHosted.title: Self-hosted
zh-CN/public.home.pricing.plans.selfHosted.note: Open source. One container, your MySQL, your own Stripe keys. No platform fee, ever.
zh-CN/public.home.flow.title: Everything between “I want to go” and “I’m here”.
zh-CN/public.home.flow.steps.publish.title: Publish
zh-CN/public.home.flow.steps.publish.text: An event page with your cover, schedule, venue and hosts. Public, unlisted, or private by invitation.
zh-CN/public.home.flow.steps.register.title: Register
zh-CN/public.home.flow.steps.register.text: Ticket tiers, your own questions, guests with their own tickets, discount codes, a waitlist when you sell out.
zh-CN/public.home.flow.steps.pay.title: Pay and receive
zh-CN/public.home.flow.steps.pay.text: Cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Pix. Tickets with a QR code, wallet passes, calendar files, confirmation by email and SMS.
zh-CN/public.home.flow.steps.checkin.title: Check in
zh-CN/public.home.flow.steps.checkin.text: A scanner that runs in any phone browser, keeps working without signal, and shows the room filling up live.
zh-CN/public.home.openSource.title: Your events. Your data. Your stack.
zh-CN/public.home.openSource.body: Evnelo is open source under the Apache 2.0 license. Host it yourself with one container and one MySQL database, plug in your own Stripe, Resend and Vonage keys, and keep every attendee record on your own infrastructure. Same product, no platform fee.

zh-CN/dashboard.checkin.empty.description: Published events appear here from the moment they go live until a day after they end.

zh-CN/dashboard.event.new.description: Saved as a draft. Add tickets and questions, then publish when it's ready.
zh-CN/dashboard.event.overview.noRegistrations.title: No registrations yet
zh-CN/dashboard.event.overview.noRegistrations.descripti: The curve starts the moment your first person signs up.

zh-CN/dashboard.event.overview.visibility.public: Public: listed on Discover and indexed.
zh-CN/dashboard.event.overview.statusNote.draft: Only you can see this event until it is published.

zh-CN/dashboard.event.overview.cancelConfirm: Cancel this event? Every registered attendee gets a cancellation email (and SMS if opted in). Paid orders still need refunding from the Orders tab.
zh-CN/dashboard.event.overview.deleteConfirm: Delete this event? It disappears from the dashboard. Attendee records are kept.
zh-CN/dashboard.event.attendees.pendingNote: {count, plural, one {# registration} other {# registrations}} waiting for your approval.

zh-CN/dashboard.event.attendees.eraseConfirm: Erase {name}'s personal data? Name, email, phone and answers are replaced with placeholders, their ticket is revoked and queued emails are dropped. This cannot be undone.
zh-CN/dashboard.event.orders.empty.title: No orders yet
zh-CN/dashboard.event.orders.empty.description: Every registration, free or paid, shows up here with what was collected.
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.title: Settings
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.description: How your organization looks in public, who can work in it, and how other systems talk to it.
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.organization.title: Organization
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.organization.description: Name, public URL, logo and the accent colour used in emails and on ticket pages.
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.organization.websiteHelp: Enter example.com and we'll add https:// automatically.
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.organization.logoHelp: Shown on event pages and emails.
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.organization.accentColourHelp: Buttons in emails and on ticket pages.
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.organization.serviceFeeHelp: Default for new events: pass the platform fee to the buyer as a line item, or absorb it.
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.members.title: Members
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.members.description: Owners and admins manage the organization; members create and run events; check-in staff can only scan tickets.
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.developer.apiKeys.title: API keys
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.developer.apiKeys.description: Server-to-server access to this organization's events, orders and attendees.
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.developer.apiKeys.note: Keys call the REST API as this organization. Send them as {header}. Read keys list and fetch; write keys also create.
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.developer.apiKeys.newKey: Copy your new key now. It will not be shown again.
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.developer.apiKeys.empty.title: No API keys yet
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.developer.apiKeys.empty.descrip: Create one per integration so you can revoke a single tool without breaking the rest.
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.developer.apiKeys.revokeConfirm: Revoke "{name}"? Requests with it stop working immediately.
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.developer.webhooks.title: Webhooks
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.developer.webhooks.description: A signed JSON POST to your own endpoint whenever something happens here.
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.developer.webhooks.note: We POST a JSON envelope to your URL for the events you pick, signed with HMAC-SHA256 ({signature} over {template}). Failed deliveries retry with backoff for about a day.
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.developer.webhooks.endpointUrlH: https only (http://localhost is allowed for development).
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.developer.webhooks.empty.title: No webhooks yet
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.developer.webhooks.empty.descri: Point one at your own service to keep a CRM, a Slack channel or a spreadsheet in step.
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.developer.webhooks.attempts: {count, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}}{hasStatus, select, true {, last {status}} other {}}
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.developer.webhooks.rotateConfir: Rotate the signing secret? The old one stops working immediately.
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.payments.title: Payments
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.payments.descriptionCloud: Paid tickets settle straight into your own Stripe account.
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.payments.descriptionSelfHosted: This instance charges through the Stripe keys its operator configured.
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.payments.connectPrompt: Connect your Stripe account to sell paid tickets. Coming with the Connect onboarding flow.
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.payments.configured: Stripe is configured. Paid tickets are charged on the instance's Stripe account with no platform fee.
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.payments.notConfigured: Stripe is not configured on this instance, so only free tickets can be sold. Set STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY to enable payments.
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.danger.title: Data and deletion
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.danger.description: Download everything this organization owns as JSON — events, orders, attendees, check-ins, settings, no secrets. Deleting the organization cancels its events, revokes every ticket, erases all attendee personal data and disables API keys and webhooks. It cannot be undone.
zh-CN/dashboard.settings.danger.ownerOnly: Only the owner can delete this organization.
zh-CN/dashboard.imageUpload.bucketRejected: The storage bucket rejected the upload. Check its CORS and policy settings.
zh-CN/dashboard.imageUpload.connectionFailed: Upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
zh-CN/dashboard.imageUpload.formats: JPEG, PNG or WebP · max 5 MB
zh-CN/dashboard.imageCrop.openFailed: That image could not be opened.
zh-CN/dashboard.imageCrop.renderFailed: This browser could not render the crop. Upload the image as it is instead.
zh-CN/dashboard.imageCrop.title: Frame the cover
zh-CN/dashboard.imageCrop.description: Drag to position and zoom to fill. Saved at 16:7, the ratio event pages use.
zh-CN/dashboard.linkTabs.label: Sections
zh-CN/dashboard.actions.savedNotified: Saved. Attendees will be told about the new time or place.
zh-CN/dashboard.actions.deletePublished: Unpublish or cancel the event before deleting it.
zh-CN/dashboard.actions.addressRateLimited: Too many address searches. Wait a minute and try again.
zh-CN/dashboard.actions.refund.noPayment: This order has no payment to refund.
zh-CN/dashboard.actions.refund.requested: Refund requested. The order updates as soon as Stripe confirms it.
zh-CN/dashboard.actions.apiKeyCreated: Key created. Copy it now; it won't be shown again.
zh-CN/dashboard.actions.eventInvite.emailFailed: Invite created, but the email could not be sent ({reason}). Share the link yourself.
zh-CN/dashboard.actions.waitlist.alreadyOffered: This person already has an open offer.
zh-CN/dashboard.actions.waitlist.noRoom: No seat is free on that ticket type (or the event is at capacity). Free one first.

zh-CN/dashboard.actions.waitlist.offered: Offer emailed to {email}; the spot is held until {deadline}.

zh-CN/dashboard.actions.deleteOrg.ownerOnly: Only an owner can delete the organization.
